title: devwork · tasks/<id>/context.md — the single task document. Frame plus living state in one frontmatter; the ledger beside it is logbook.jsonl under logbook-event.schema.json.
description: Ruled by Calo 2026-09-28 (logbook 187: one document per task, context.md plus status) and 2026-09-29 (logbook 195.6: one logbook.jsonl per task). Dialect kind with role beside it (193), para the only human field (145). The living-state fields keep the names and the enum of status.schema.json so the store import stays a rename. project_id is optional: the tasks with no derivable world keep their gap (leg-8 prohibition), they do not invent one.

role.description: one line of prose: what a session opened on this task is for

task_id.description: the folder slug, as brain derives it

project_id.description: the world, from wosy edge about; absent when no world is derivable

root.description: absolute path of the task folder

para.description: the bounded objective, written by Calo, in Spanish. The only human field

entity.description: badge (factory-redesign logbook 77): the thing the task is about, one line, e.g. merchant 600031705, source 22199.csv

route.description: badge: where to look first, in order; a library query, a runbook or a table, each an absolute path or a name

out_of_scope.description: badge: what the task does not touch

neighbours.description: badge: task ids that share an entity or a ticket with this one, from wosy edge

world_doc.description: badge: absolute path of the world master.md this task runs inside

ledger.description: absolute path of the task ledger, one event per line under logbook-event.schema.json

source_ref.description: the status.md or kickstart this document recreates, or the generator
